chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Marim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Al-Mut'ah (temporary marriage) is that upon which the Quran was revealed and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) proceeded.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic and Prophetic basis for temporary marriage (Mut'ah) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar is a cornerstone of the Shia position on al-Mut'ah, asserting its permanence by linking it to the Quranic revelation and the continuous Sunnah of the Prophet. It specifically counters the Sunni view that the practice was abrogated (naskh) by citing the enduring nature of the prophetic tradition. The narration underscores that Mut'ah was not merely a temporary concession but a established legal institution governed by divine text and prophetic practice.
